order: Order easily via WhatsApp and collect your freshly prepared chicken dishes at our food truck at the time we confirm.

Collection at our food truck only. No delivery or online payment. Your order is final only after we confirm it.
event: Organising a birthday, company party, neighbourhood celebration, festival or another event? OranjeKip serves freshly prepared chicken dishes from our food truck at your location.
Tell us the date, location, event type and expected number of guests. We will gladly discuss options and provide a no-obligation quote.

dictionary.OranjeKip is een mobiele halal foodtruck: OranjeKip is a mobile halal food truck that passionately prepares freshly grilled chicken dishes. Founded by two friends who love great food and good company, we bring authentic chicken flavours to markets and events in Brabant. Whether you enjoy whole chicken, drumsticks or our famous crispy hot wings, quality and friendly service always come first. Visit us and taste the care in every dish!
